8.19.2. iLock_Geography.lcf.parse.parseLCF2Par¶

iLock_Geography.lcf.parse.parseLCF2Par(path, namespaceSep=None)¶

Parses a file according to the LCF2Par-cfg-1.1 or LCF2PAR-cfg-2.0 format. No semantical validation of the file content is made, i.e. the returned rules may refer to unknown tables, predicates, etc.

Parameters:
  • path – Path to file to be parsed.
  • namespaceSep – Separator used to distinguish the PiSPEC class name from the parameter name. E.g. if dest-param is “FOO@bar” and namespaceSep=’@’, the rule will be interpreted to apply to the ‘foo’ parameter in the PiSPEC class ‘BAR’. Defaults to ‘@’.
Returns:

A list of ParRule instances.
Return type:

list(ParRule)
